questiontext.text:
Find the number of permutation of the word {@word@}

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

[[ if test='K=4' ]]

The word {@word@} has {@word1@} different letters; \({@W1-n1@}\,, {@W2-n2@}\,, {@W3-n3@}\).

\(k=4\, , n_1=1 \, , n_2=2 \, , n_3=1\)

We get that the total number of arrangements is

\(\displaystyle=\frac{4!}{1! \, 2!\, 1!}\)

\(={@ta@}\)

[[ elif test='K=6' ]]

The word {@word@} has {@word1@} different letters; \({@W1-n1@}\,, {@W2-n2@}\,, {@W3-n3@}\,, {@W4-n4@}\).

\(k=6\, , n_1=2 \, , n_2=2 \, , n_3=1 \, , n_4=1 \)

We get that the total number of arrangements is

\(\displaystyle=\frac{6!}{2! \, 2!\, 1! \, 1!}\)

\(={@ta@}\)

[[ elif test='K=8' ]]

The word {@word@} has {@word1@} different letters; \({@W1-n1@}\,, {@W2-n2@}\,, {@W3-n3@}\,, {@W4-n4@}\,,{@W5-n5@}\).

\(k=8\, , n_1=1 \, , n_2=2 \, , n_3=2\, , n_4=2\, , n_5=1\)

We get that the total number of arrangements is

\(\displaystyle=\frac{8!}{1! \, 2!\, 2!\, 2!\, 1!}\)

\(={@ta@}\)

[[ else ]]

The word {@word@} has {@word1@} different letters; \({@W1-n1@}\,, {@W2-n2@}\,, {@W3-n3@}\,, {@W4-n4@},{@W5-n5@},{@W6-n6@}\).

\(k=8\, , n_1=2 \, , n_2=2 \, , n_3=1\, , n_4=1\, , n_5=1\, , n_6=1\)

We get that the total number of arrangements is

\(\displaystyle=\frac{8!}{2! \, 2!\, 1!\, 1!\, 1!}\)

\(={@ta@}\)

[[/ if]]
